name: Qwen 3.5 9B
short: Alibaba's Feb-Mar 2026 dense 9.65B open-weight multimodal model (Apache 2.0, 262K): tau2 86.8%, LiveCodeBench v6 65.6%, MMMU-Pro 70.1% at ~$0.10/$0.15 - not on Zen.
